obligation: G009 / [S006 14] -- can any two physical numbers in this campaign be compared?
rule: S006 14: every physical receipt must identify specimen, NR, runtime, context, path, concurrency, and numbers across mismatched contracts must not be compared.
instrument: tools/future/tps_contract.py -- a validator, not a measurer.
classifier_note: PHYSICAL means the receipt carries a NUMERIC rate key. Substring matching on the serialized text was tried first and called 282 of 443 receipts physical, including a namespace audit and a dead-callsite sweep, because 'decode' and 'toks' appear in prose. That inflated denominator would have made the result look far worse than it is.
finding: 77 physical receipts carry a measured rate. 1 of them identify all six fields. The campaign cannot legitimately compare any two of its own physical numbers under its own rule.
already_paid_for_this: O003 carried two decode figures 25% apart, 87.67 and 69.97. The disagreement could not be resolved by re-reading them because NEITHER recorded its mlx_lm version, so 69.97's compute path was unreconstructable. It had to be settled by internal consistency instead: 87.67 x 5.158 GB/token = 452.2 GB/s matched that receipt's own recorded bandwidth exactly. A recorded `runtime` field would have settled it in one line.
does_not_claim: that these 77 numbers are WRONG. They are unreproducible and mutually incomparable, which is a different and narrower charge. Each may be perfectly correct for the conditions it was taken under; those conditions were simply not written down.
next: New physical receipts carry the six fields. Old ones are not retrofitted from memory -- a contract reconstructed after the fact is a guess wearing a receipt's clothes.
